starting_plan: Implement Transformer Encoder for EHR sequences
Implement Graph Neural Network (GNN) for patient similarity

sanity_checks: Fusion Paradox verified (Early Fusion degrades performance).
Post-HPO, multiple Transformer-based fusion models cluster near the GRU+XGBoost baseline, suggesting an AUC ceiling around 0.64 on this cohort.

impact.utility: Validates Transformer > GRU for clinical timelines (+0.007 AUROC) and shows that carefully tuned fusion (Gated / MLP HPO) can nearly match a strong XGBoost baseline.
impact.robustness: Gated Fusion and HPO-tuned MLP remain robust to text noise and calibration issues.
impact.decision_readiness: Shortlist of candidate models (GRU XGBoost, GRU Gated Fusion, Transformer MLP HPO) is ready for pilot shadow mode.
risks: Small sample size (15k) limits Deep Learning potential.

deviations: Switched from DGL to PyG due to dependency issues.

open_questions.question: Does GNN add value over Gated Fusion?
Can we break the ~0.64 AUC ceiling without more data?
open_questions.evidence_needed: Experiments on larger or less restricted cohorts, or refined labels, showing consistent gains over current best models.

next_steps.action: Formalize MLflow-backed HPO scripts (XGBoost, PyTorch MLP, Gated Fusion) as canonical entry points for future sweeps.
next_steps.success: All new experiments log train/val/test metrics and appear in the consolidated comparison table.

next_steps.action: Compare calibration and threshold behavior for GRU XGBoost vs GRU Gated Fusion vs Transformer MLP HPO.
next_steps.success: Selected deployment candidate with documented operating point (precision/recall trade-off).
